summary:
On June 6, 2024, Sunita Williams and Barry Wilmore went on an eight-day test mission aboard the Boeing Starliner spacecraft. However, due to a technical malfunction, they were stranded in space for nearly nine months.
   Sunita Williams, one of the Boeing Starliner astronauts, graduated from Needham High School in 1983. She received her university degree in 1987 and earned a master's degree in engineering from the University of Florida in 1995.
   The other astronaut, Barry Wilmore, graduated from Mount Juliet High School. He earned a master's degree in electrical engineering and was the captain of the Tennessee Tech football team.
   The spacecraft they traveled in, Boeing Starliner, went on a test flight in June 2024, but its return to Earth was postponed due to an accident.
    The two decided to carry out the test flight because they wanted to spend the rest of their careers as astronauts. During the mission, docking problems and loss of thrust occurred. Since returning was considered risky, they remained stranded in space for nine months.
   At the end of his period, they returned to Earth on March 19, 2025, aboard the SpaceX Crew-9 capsule.
details:
This project aims to simulate the story we have written in an interactive way.

     At the beginning of the project, our spacecraft is traveling to Mars. Since our story takes place on Mars, we first need to reach the planet. After landing on Mars, we see a spacecraft. By clicking on its door, we enter the spacecraft.

     Inside the spacecraft, there is a cryptex capsule. When we click on the capsule, we are asked to enter a password. The password is IRIDIUM.
Once we enter the correct password, the capsule opens and provides us with some information in Esperanto.

    To understand and translate this information, we need to click on the dictionary section. After translating the information, we click the apply
button to complete the necessary steps. Using the information we have obtained, we build our rocket and successfully return to Earth.     

     Through this project, our story becomes an educational and entertaining simulation in which users can interact with the environment, solve puzzles, and progress by completing different tasks.
